 CJ OLIVE YOUNG to open four-floor color cosmetics specialty store, ‘COLOR GROUND Hongdae,’ in Seoul
 by Janessa Macaraig 
 - 
 November 18, 2026
 Our What’s NEXT in Marketing 2026 Conference Series returns to the Philippines , Singapore , Hong Kong , Indonesia , Malaysia —and for the first time in Thailand ! Brace yourself for bold ideas driving the next marketing wave. Click here to learn more!
 South Korea – CJ OLIVE YOUNG will open “COLOR GROUND Hongdae” in Seogyo-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul, launching its first specialty retail store dedicated exclusively to color cosmetics to propel Korean makeup into a primary global growth driver for K-beauty.
 Spanning four floors and approximately 575 square meters in a district where international shoppers account for 84% of OLIVE YOUNG sales and consumers in their teens and twenties make up over half, the store is designed as a Gen Z- and Gen Alpha-focused “color cosmetics playground.”  
 Moving away from traditional brand-by-brand shelving, “COLOR GROUND Hongdae” introduces segment-based merchandising that groups items by product type, formulation, and function, allowing shoppers to compare offerings across brands based on individual preferences.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by 올리브영 OLIVE YOUNG (@oliveyoung_official) 
 To spotlight emerging K-beauty labels, 26% of the store’s color cosmetics lineup features brands making their OLIVE YOUNG debut in a dedicated third-floor “Rookie Zone.” The four-story space also combines themed product and lounge zones with interactive tools, including “QUICK TOUCH UP MOOD” look trials, “SKIN SCAN COLOR FIT” color analysis, and “Beautication” tutorial videos.
 The launch builds on strong category momentum, as OLIVE YOUNG’s color cosmetics sales achieved a 36% compound annual growth rate over the past five years, while South Korean color cosmetics exports reached $1.11 billion from January to September 2026 within a global market estimated at $105.2 billion.
 An OLIVE YOUNG spokesperson said, “The ‘glass skin’ look that has captivated beauty consumers around the world is achieved not through skincare alone, but also through Korean color cosmetics that create a natural, refined complexion.”
 “We aim to turn the potential of Korean color cosmetics into new growth opportunities and work alongside promising Korean brands to help establish K-beauty as a mainstream force in the global beauty industry,” added the OLIVE YOUNG spokesperson. 
 Through this category-focused retail model and a strategic push into accessible functional makeup, OLIVE YOUNG aims to incubate emerging domestic brands and establish Korean color cosmetics as a mainstream pillar of the global beauty market.
